diagnosis: All four rollouts successfully revealed both PF1 (by A2) and PF2 (by A3) and cited both in justification_fact_ids, and provenance check P1 passed in every rollout. The gate failed because content checks C1, C2, C3, and C5 are encoding mismatches: the models produce correct decisions but in formats the checks do not accept. C1 passed only in rollout 2 where hold_status was "continue" but failed in rollouts 0, 1, and 3 where it was "continued". C2 passed only in rollouts 0 and 3 where hold_end_date was ISO-formatted "2027-03-31" but failed in rollouts 1 and 2 where it was "March 31, 2026". C3 passed in zero rollouts despite all settlements listing the correct three preserved groups, suggesting the check expects a specific group-name format (e.g., hyphenated "sales-operations") that no model produced. C5 passed in zero rollouts despite every settlement setting customer_support_archive_snapshot_required=true and including a snapshot-creation commitment with the February 14, 2026 date in the detail text, suggesting the check looks for a structured snapshot-date field that the settlement schema does not contain. No rollout hit the turn cap; all settled naturally.
